functions.name: POSITION
functions.description: The type to get the value from the position. The first parameter is the number of the column with positionId. Column numbering starting from 0. The second parameter is the name of the fields in the position, for example PositionProfit, AmountAsBigDecimal, AmountExp, CloseCrossPrice, LastPrice. Example "POSITION(positionId, PositionProfit)"

functions.name: ACCOUNT
functions.description: The type to get the value from the account. The first parameter is the number of the column with account id. Column numbering starting from 0. The second parameter is the name of the fields in the account, for example AllPositionProfit, DailyLoss, WeeklyLos. The third parameter is optional, you can specify scale. Example "ACCOUNT(accountId,AllPositionProfit,2)"

functions.name: USER
functions.description: The type to get the value from the user. The first parameter is the number of the column with user Id. Column numbering starting from 0. The second parameter is the name of the fields in the user, for example FullAddress, CurrentBalance, Balance, DailyPnL. At the end must be the return type. Example "USER(userId,FullAddress):RETURNS{STRING}"

functions.name: POSITION_DAILY_PNL
functions.description: Column type to get daily position PnL. First parameter - column index with position id, after one different parameters, example: todate:2 - index column with date, for:system - currency type with available values: system, account, position. spread:true- spread true or false. first day calculation (day closing price - position opening price) * lots * lotsize * * crossprices * ...,  middle day (day closing price - prevous day closing price) * lots * lotsize * crossprices *..., last day calculation (position closing price - previous day closing price) * lots * lotsize * crossprices * ..., Warning: As of now, will likely fail ungracefully when used with one position.

functions.name: ACTIVE_ORDER
functions.description: Column type to get order value by method name. First parameter - column index with order id, second parametr - name of method. Available values: CrossPriceForManualOrder, SpreadedPrice, PendingAmount, UnSpreadedPrice

functions.name: POSITION_ACCOUNT_WITH_ASSET_MIN_CHANGE
functions.description: The type to get the value with asset min change (examle precision = 0.01) from the position. The first parameter is the number of the column with positionId. Column numbering starting from 0. The second parameter is the name of the fields in the position, for example PositionProfit, AmountAsBigDecimal, AmountExp, CloseCrossPrice, LastPrice. Example "POSITION_ACCOUNT_WITH_ASSET_MIN_CHANGE(positionId, PositionProfit)"

functions.name: NUMBER_ACCOUNT_WITH_ASSET_MIN_CHANGE
functions.description: Column type for get nummber account with minimum min asset's step. Example NUMBER_ACCOUNT_WITH_ASSET_MIN_CHANGE(positionId), where 0 - column index with position id

functions.name: POSITION_CURRENT_PRICE
functions.description: Column type to get position current price. First parameter - column index with position id, after one different parameters, example: todate:2 - index column with date, spread:true- spread true or false. quoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. Example POSITION_CURRENT_PRICE(positionId,todate:2,quoteperiodtype:minute,spread:true,CurrentPrice)

functions.name: POSITION_MARGIN
functions.description: Column type to get position margin. First parameter - column index with position id, after one different parameters, example: todate:2 - index column with date, for:system - currency type with available values: system, account, position. spread:true- spread true or false. quoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. crossquoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. init:true - paremeter with values true or false, if true to get init margin, else to get Maintance margin. Example POSITION_MARGIN(positionId,todate:2,quoteperiodtype:minute,spread:true)

functions.name: ACCOUNT_EQUITY
functions.description: Column type to get account equity. First parameter - column index with position id, after one different parameters, example: todate:2 - index column with date, for:system - currency type with available values: system, account, position. spread:true- spread true or false. quoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. crossquoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. accountinfo:2 - column index with account id. Example ACCOUNT_EQUITY(positionId,todate:4,spread:true,quoteperiodtype:minute,accountinfo:2,AccountEquity)[nosum]

functions.name: CALC
functions.description: CALC(column[14]*100/column[15],MarginUsed):RETURNS{FORMATED_NUMBER}

functions.name: POSITION_EXPOSURE
functions.description: Column type to get position exposure. Formula: real amount * legacy close price * close cross price * cross price. First parameter - column index with position id, after one different parameters, example: todate:2 - index column with date, for:system - currency type with available values: system, account, position. spread:true- spread true or false. quoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. crossquoteperiodtype:minute - quote period type with values day or minute. Example POSITION_EXPOSURE(positionId,todate:2,for:system,quoteperiodtype:minute,crossquoteperiodtype:minute)

functions.name: ACCOUNT_CUSTOM_CONDITIONS_MARGIN
functions.description: Column type to get value from account with margin. Example ACCOUNT_CUSTOM_CONDITIONS_MARGIN(0,MaintenanceMargin,1), where first parameter - column index with account id, second parameter - the name of the method whose value we need to get. Examples ProfitForMargin, Balance, FullBalance, LockedSum, CreditSum, ReservedBalance, AllPositionProfit, Equity, UnsettledDeposit, BalanceNRisk, InitMargin, MaintenanceMargin, AvailableToWithdraw, DailyPnL, AvailableFunds, TotalMargin, StockValue, BlockedForStocks. Third parameter - margin calcualtor type, available values -1, 0, 1. None - -1, ACCOUNT_OPTION_MARGIN - 0, ACCOUNT_PORTFOLIO_MARGIN - 1

functions.name: POSITION_MARGIN_OR_PORTFOLIO_STRING
functions.description: Column type to get margin for position or "Portfolio" if margin type for position is PTRM or CBOE. Example POSITION_MARGIN_OR_PORTFOLIO_STRING(positionId,MaintenanceMargin,Margin), where first parameter - column index with position id,second parameter - the name of the method whose value we need to get. Available values: InitialMargin, MaintenanceMargin, ActualAmount
